description: Fix common typos: gmial.com, hotmail.con, yaho.com, stray spaces/dots. Returns the suggestion (or null) and which fixes applied. Free. Example: email 'sara@gmial.con'. Response: result with status (deliverable | risky | undeliverable | invalid | unknown), reason, score 0–100, the checks run, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. No logging of addresses.
name: suggest_fix
title: Suggest a correction for a mistyped address
